formal_statement: PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize 8 (fun x : Fin 8 → Bool => (x 0 && x 1) || (x 1 && x 2) || (x 2 && x 3) || (x 0 && x 4) || (x 1 && x 5) || (x 2 && x 6) || (x 3 && x 7) || (x 4 && x 6) || (x 5 && x 7) || (x 7 && x 4)) 12
plain_statement: On eight inputs, take the Petersen graph minus two adjacent vertices: edges 0-1, 1-2, 2-3, 0-4, 1-5, 2-6, 3-7, 4-6, 5-7, 7-4. Some circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 12 gates computes the function true exactly when both ends of some edge are true.
title: Petersen graph minus two adjacent vertices: some circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 12 gates computes its edge function
